_comment: wq#3808 LIMPET meta-server registry manifest. Edit this file and the running meta-server picks up the change within reload_poll_sec (or immediately on SIGHUP, which cuts the wait short) with no restart. Changing an mcp_servers entry's command or env restarts that child; startup_timeout_sec/request_timeout_sec bound every read from it, so a child that stops answering costs only its own tools (wq#3821).

mcp_servers.name: rea
mcp_servers.note: SECURITY HOLD per TOOL_REGISTRY.md (wq#3786): astroturfed star velocity, no independent audit. Do not flip to true without a Frank-reviewed TOOL_REGISTRY.md status change.

mcp_servers.name: ghidra
mcp_servers.note: placeholder entry: no Ghidra MCP server installed on Limpet yet, wire up command/env when it is. Timeouts raised off the 10s/30s defaults as the shape a slow-booting, long-analysis child wants - a child is only skipped once it blows its own budget.

cli_tools.name: strings
cli_tools.description: Print printable character sequences from a file (no MCP server of its own, so it's CLI-wrapped).

cli_tools.name: file
cli_tools.description: Identify a file's type (no MCP server of its own, so it's CLI-wrapped).

cli_tools.name: ofrak-unpack
cli_tools.description: Recursively unpack a binary/firmware image with OFRAK; writes a resource-tree manifest into workdir.
cli_tools.note: LICENSING HOLD per TOOL_REGISTRY.md 'OFRAK' (wq#3967): the OFRAK Community License excludes Shared Use, which is exactly how the meta-server runs this. Needs an OFRAK Pro/Enterprise license from Red Balloon Security before enabling. Do not flip to true without that purchase.

cli_tools.name: ofrak-list-resources
cli_tools.description: List the resource tree OFRAK found in a prior ofrak-unpack call.

cli_tools.name: ofrak-patch-bytes
cli_tools.description: Patch raw bytes at an offset into the resource OFRAK unpacked, then repack it into workdir/patched.bin.

cli_tools.name: ofrak-patch-strings
cli_tools.description: Find-and-replace a same-length string in the resource OFRAK unpacked, then repack it into workdir/patched.bin.

cli_tools.name: ofrak-repack
cli_tools.description: Deliver the patched binary OFRAK produced to the requested output path, with sha256 provenance.
